assessmentSecurity.title: Assessment security
assessmentSecurity.subtitle: Choose how the TIMS tests your candidates take from the ATS are protected. These are the same controls the TIMS assessment platform uses.
assessmentSecurity.noPermission: You don't have permission to change these settings. Ask an HR administrator.
assessmentSecurity.lockdownHelp: The test opens full screen and blocks shortcuts such as copy and paste. If the candidate has a second screen connected, they can't start until they disconnect it.
assessmentSecurity.antiCheatHelp: Counts the test's alerts: switching tabs, leaving the window or connecting another screen. The candidate sees a warning with each alert.
assessmentSecurity.antiCheatOffHint: Off: alerts are recorded, but they never change anything about the test.
assessmentSecurity.thresholdHelp: When this number is reached, what you choose below happens. Between {min} and {max}.

warn.label: Only warn
warn.help: The candidate keeps going. The alerts are recorded.

auto_submit.label: Submit the test
auto_submit.help: The test closes with the answers given so far. The result goes to review: a person decides.

void.label: Void the test
void.help: The test is voided and the attempt counts as used. To retake it, assign it again.

assessmentSecurity.identityHelp: Uses the camera: takes a photo of the candidate at the start and compares it with periodic photos during the test. It needs the candidate's biometric consent, which they are asked for before starting.
assessmentSecurity.identityUnavailable: Not available yet: it needs a biometric consent text approved by TIMS that describes the camera check. We'll turn it on when it's ready.
assessmentSecurity.appliesNote: Changes apply to the tests you assign from now on. Tests already assigned keep the settings they were sent with.
assessmentSecurity.pcaNote: The PCA is taken on its provider's site and doesn't use these controls.
assessmentSecurity.saved: Settings saved. They apply to the next tests you assign.
assessmentSecurity.saveError: The settings couldn't be saved. Try again.
assessmentSecurity.identityRefused: The identity check isn't available yet.
assessmentSecurity.unavailableBody: Ask TIMS to turn them on for your organization; these settings will appear here.
